review_question: Does the package implement a safe, reusable five-role equilibrium review without treating missing evidence as agreement?

initial_reviews.finding: The package distinguishes facts, hypotheses, missing evidence, and release limits, and records not-run status conservatively.
The package has a reusable output contract for documents, data evaluations, reports, hypotheses, and skills.
The script uses explicit argument vectors, shell=false, safe dry-run defaults, and no provider or credential discovery.

disruptor.finding: A five-way dry run with no initial evidence originally labeled an exploratory disruptor as release-review input.
disruptor.test_result: Failed self-review expectation; patched authority labeling to exploratory-only whenever initial material agreement is absent.

negotiator.rationale: Structural, fixture, and orchestration checks pass. No live external agent-quality benchmark or unseen holdout exists.

limitations: The mock adapter validates subprocess orchestration and record parsing, not reviewer correctness.
No independent provider contexts or domain-specialist judgments were available during package creation.
No production-readiness, uplift, or general task-quality claim is authorized.
next_evidence: Run matched live reviews with separated contexts or model families.
Add a protected or external holdout spanning at least three artifact domains.
Grade reviewer findings against human or domain-specialist adjudication.
